894cce8f0ef3.title: Apprentice Automotive Technician
894cce8f0ef3.description_html:
Apprentice Automotive Technician - Honda of Libertyville

Honda of Libertyville, part of the Murgado Automotive Group, is hiring a full-time Apprentice Automotive Technician for our busy and growing service department in Libertyville, IL. This is an on-site opportunity for technicians with 1 to 3 years of automotive repair experience who want steady work, hands-on training, and the opportunity to grow with a supportive dealership team.

You will perform maintenance, inspections, and light to moderate repairs while building your diagnostic skills and working with modern tools, dealership repair procedures, and an experienced service team. Honda experience and ASE certifications are a plus, but we welcome motivated technicians who are eager to learn and continue developing their automotive career.

Busy Shop. Steady Hours. Growth Opportunity. This position pays $18 to $22 per hour, based on experience, skills, and qualifications. We are looking for motivated technicians who are ready to grow, learn, and contribute in a shop that stays busy.

Our advisors and service leadership team are focused on keeping work moving, supporting technicians, and helping team members build confidence and long-term skills.

If you are looking for:

  • A busy dealership service department.
  • Steady full-time work.
  • Supportive leadership and experienced teammates.
  • Opportunities to keep learning and improving.
  • A place where reliability, effort, and quality work are valued.

This could be the right next step for you.

Benefits

  • Pay range: $18 to $22 per hour, based on experience and qualifications.
  • Busy shop with no shortage of work.
  • Steady full-time opportunity with room to grow.
  • Hands-on experience with dealership repair procedures and modern diagnostic tools.
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance.
  • Retirement plan options.
  • Ongoing training and career development.
  • Supportive dealership team environment.
  • Growth opportunities within the Murgado Automotive Group.

A New Direction

We have built a strong leadership team, improved our processes, invested in our people, and created an environment where technicians can succeed.

Our focus is simple:

  • Keep the shop loaded with work.
  • Dispatch fairly.
  • Support our technicians.
  • Reward performance.

If you are dependable, motivated, and ready to build your career, we want to hear from you.

Responsibilities

  • Perform routine maintenance, including oil changes, tire rotations, brake inspections, fluid services, and manufacturer-recommended maintenance.
  • Perform light to moderate mechanical, electrical, brake, suspension, HVAC, and drivability repairs.
  • Use diagnostic equipment, technical manuals, and repair procedures to help identify vehicle concerns accurately.
  • Complete repairs efficiently while meeting dealership quality and safety standards.
  • Inspect vehicles, document findings, and recommend appropriate repairs or maintenance.
  • Communicate clearly with service advisors about diagnoses, repair timelines, and recommended services.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work area.
  • Follow dealership policies, manufacturer guidelines, and safety procedures.

Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • 1 to 3 years of experience as an Automotive Technician in a dealership or automotive repair facility preferred.
  • Automotive technical training program, apprenticeship, or equivalent hands-on experience preferred.
  • Basic to intermediate diagnostic, troubleshooting, mechanical, and electrical repair skills.
  • Ability to use diagnostic equipment, hand tools, and service information systems.
  • ASE certification or Honda manufacturer certification is a plus.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality workmanship.
  • Valid driver’s license and acceptable driving record required.

About Honda of Libertyville

Honda of Libertyville is a premier Honda dealership serving the Libertyville area and a proud member of the Murgado Automotive Group. We are committed to excellent customer service, high-quality automotive solutions, and a professional work environment where technicians can grow their careers. We are also an easy commute – easy to get to from Fox Lake, Lake Villa, Gurnee, Grayslake, Mundelein, and more!

Apply Today

If you are an Automotive Technician with 1 to 3 years of experience looking for a full-time dealership opportunity in Libertyville, IL, apply today to join the Honda of Libertyville service team.

Murgado Automotive Group is an equal opportunity employer. Murgado Automotive Group does not discriminate in employment on account of race/ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation/transgender status, age disability, martial/parental status, citizenship status, military status, political affiliation and/or beliefs, pregnancy, order of protection status or other non-merit status.
We are an employer who participates in the E-verify program with the Department of Homeland and Security.

89abf8019c6b.title: Software Engineer (New Grad)
89abf8019c6b.description_html:
A Better Built World

At Miter, we’re on a mission to help construction contractors build with confidence. If we’re successful, we’ll make it easier and faster to build critical physical infrastructure - roads, bridges, utilities, data centers, housing, etc.

For decades, construction and field services contractors have had to run their businesses on outdated software: clunky, on-premise systems created in the 1980s and 1990s.

That’s where Miter comes in. We’re using AI and embedded payments to rebuild the core HR, finance, and operations systems that underpin our physical economy. Using Miter, contractors like Marathon Electrical, W.J. O’Neil, and Truebeck Construction are building stronger teams, controlling job costs, and accelerating jobsite execution.

This idea is resonating. Since we launched in 2021, we’ve grown to thousands of customers and tens of millions in ARR, making us one of the fastest growing vertical software companies ever. To double-down on our momentum, we’ve raised $50M+ from top investors (Bessemer, Coatue, and Battery) who share our belief that we’re just getting started.

About the Team and How We Work:

Building the OS for the built world is no small feat. We’ll need to ship a LOT of high quality code in the coming years, and to do so, we’re building an engineering culture centered around craft, ownership, and collaboration. >25% of our engineers and product managers are ex-founders, and we hire for slope, not intercept. Being a place where you can just build things requires talent density and some unique ways of doing things.

A few ways we’re different:

  • No rules…rules: Many engineering teams design processes and rules around the lowest common denominator. Not us! We trust brilliant engineers to deliver magical customer outcomes and introduce processes and rules only when necessary.

  • Full-full-stack: Our technology stack (TypeScript everywhere!) and processes are designed to encourage engineers to run their projects end-to-end. This usually involves writing technical blueprints, implementing full-stack solutions, and talking to customers directly to get feedback.

  • Lean and AI-native: AI is turning 10x engineers into 100x engineers. We believe lean, talent-dense, AI-native teams will outship much larger teams with less talent density.

  • Blueprints and building blocks: One of our core Miter values is “build the blueprint”. Writing things down clarifies our thinking and aligns our teams. This also applies to building fundamental building blocks and abstractions that make developers’ lives easier.

  • We feel our customers’ pain and celebrate their success: We encourage engineers to build direct relationships with customers, feel their pain, and celebrate their success. We love fast feedback loops.

  • We’re meritocratic: We value results and hard work. We reward engineers who consistently ship and deliver for customers with increased scope and compensation.

What You'll Do:

  • Design, build, and maintain products/systems that power our core platform.

  • Collaborate with product managers and other engineers to deliver high-quality experiences.

  • Actively participate in blueprinting, code reviews, and technical documentation for your team.

What You'll Need:

  • 0-1 years of professional software development experience.

  • Strong problem-solving skills.

  • A growth mindset and curiosity to understand business context and user needs.

  • Strong work ethic and reliability when owning tasks and deliverables.

  • A team-oriented attitude with humility and openness to new ideas.

Our Tech Stack:

  • React + React Native

  • Node/Express

  • MongoDB

  • Render

  • Check

  • Stripe (Issuing, Treasury)

  • Typescript

Our Interview Process:

  • Recruiter Intro

  • A technical screen where we pair on a real-life problem

  • A (virtual) onsite!

    • Practical coding exercise

    • Miter values with Engineering leader

Our Benefits:

  • Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive (well above “market”) salary, commission, and equity packages.

  • Medical Insurance: Comprehensive medical, dental, FSA, vision plans to suit you and your family’s needs.

  • 401(k) Retirement Plan: Company-matched contributions to help you plan for your future.

  • Flexible PTO: Take the time you need to recharge and be your best self.

  • Parental Leave: Generous 16-week paid leave for all parents, including adoptive and foster parents.

  • Learning & Development: We offer every employee an annual educational allowance to explore external professional development.

  • Office Extras: Snacks, coffee, lunch, and commuter benefits for in-office Mitosaurs.

  • Community: Company-wide and team-specific off-sites per year.

Hybrid vs. Remote Approach:

We believe the magic of Miter comes from working side by side. We also believe in work flexibility. For roles that are listed as hybrid, our approach is 3 days a week in the office giving us the chance to connect, brainstorm, and build stronger relationships. If you live within a reasonable commute to either our New York City or San Francisco offices, we ask that you work in our hybrid approach.

Otherwise, for roles listed as remote or in other cities where we don't have an office location, there is no requirement to work in our hybrid approach. We do travel a few times a year for onboarding, company-wide and team specific off-sites!

Join our Talent Community

Not seeing a role that matches your background right now? Apply to our Talent Community, and we’ll reach out if a role opens up that aligns with your experience!

Equal Opportunity:

Miter provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

Use of Artificial Intelligence in Our Hiring Process:

Miter uses AI-assisted tools as part of our hiring process to help our recruiting team manage and review applications more efficiently. We want to be transparent about how this works.

What the AI does: When you apply to a role at Miter, an AI tool may review your application against the specific qualifications and requirements posted for that job. This tool identifies whether your experience appears to meet, partially meet, or not meet each stated requirement, and it provides supporting evidence from your application for every assessment it makes.

What the AI does not do: The AI does not make hiring decisions. It does not reject, advance, or rank candidates on its own, and it does not assign you a numerical score. Every application is reviewed by a member of our recruiting team, who makes the final call on whether you move forward. The AI is a tool that helps our team prioritize their time across a high volume of applications. It is not a substitute for human judgment.

What information it uses: The tool evaluates the application materials you submit (your resume and any other application content) against role-specific criteria our team has defined. It does not pull information from external sources such as social media or professional networking profiles, and personal identifying information is removed from your materials before any AI review takes place.

Human oversight: Our recruiting team periodically reviews how these tools are performing to check for unintended patterns in outcomes, and we retain the ability to override any AI-generated assessment at any time.
